name: Makkah and Madinah (Umrah)
summary: Islam's two holiest cities. Umrah can be performed all year; plan with a registered agency for visa, hotels and transfers, and respect crowd rules.
season_note: November to February is mild. Summer is very hot; Ramadan and Hajj season are extremely crowded and prices rise sharply.
avoid_note: Summer midday heat is dangerous; stay hydrated and avoid peak crowds if elderly.
entry_note: Saudi Arabia: Bangladeshis normally travel for Umrah through a registered agency with visa arranged via the Nusuk/Umrah system; follow current Ministry of Hajj guidelines and check the latest rules with the embassy before booking.

reach.how: Dhaka to Jeddah (King Abdulaziz) or Madinah (Prince Mohammad bin Abdulaziz) (Biman, Saudia, flynas, US-Bangla)
reach.note: Direct flights about 5h30m; Biman and Saudia operate. Prices rise at Ramadan and Hajj.

local.note: Jeddah airport to Makkah by agency.

attractions.name: Masjid al-Haram and Kaaba (Umrah)
attractions.what: The Grand Mosque; perform Tawaf and Sai.
attractions.tip: Wear ihram properly; avoid peak prayer times with elders.

attractions.name: Jabal al-Nour and Cave Hira
attractions.what: The mountain of the first revelation; steep climb.
attractions.tip: Not suitable for the elderly; climb early.

attractions.name: Masjid an-Nabawi and Rawdah
attractions.what: The Prophet's Mosque; Rawdah visits need Nusuk booking.
attractions.tip: Book Rawdah slot on Nusuk app.

attractions.name: Masjid Quba
attractions.tip: Make wudu at home and pray 2 rakat.

attractions.name: Mount Uhud and Martyrs Cemetery
attractions.what: Site of the Battle of Uhud.

attractions.name: Mount Arafat and Mina (viewing)
attractions.what: Hajj sites; Umrah visitors may take ziyarat tours.

rules: Non-Muslims cannot enter Makkah or Madinah's Haram area.
Follow ihram rules; no perfume, no cutting hair, etc.
Photography inside the Haram has restrictions; be respectful.
Carry your Umrah permit and agency ID.
